combo_label: Things That Beep × Birds & Birdwatching × Castles & Medieval Life

entries.clue: Tip-to-tip measure: inches in a sparrow, a good three metres in an albatross
Pied car-park sprinter whose rear end never once stops bobbing up and down
Sworn brotherhood of one trade, fixing prices and vetting every apprentice
Belt-clipped relic that beeps doctors out of their lunch break.
Car safety strap with a chime that nags until you buckle it.
Lake diver that courts face to face, rearing up breast to breast with weed held out
Splayed recess hollowed inside a thick wall so a bowman can swing his aim
Shop's chirping cash drawer, springing open with a triumphant ding.
Sci-fi tin sidekick that speaks fluent boop-and-whirr.
A bird's whole feathered coat, drab through winter and dazzling by spring
Two riders thundering at each other on opposite sides of a wooden rail
Great tower at the heart of a stronghold, the last refuge once the walls were lost
